turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: How's the experience been generating long-form audiobook content in bulk?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Bulk generation for a 10-hour audiobook took about 40 minutes end to end, which is fast. Quality stayed consistent from chapter 1 to chapter 30, no noticeable drift.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Any issues with bulk jobs specifically?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: If one chapter fails mid-batch, the whole batch doesn't tell you which chapter failed in the response — we have to check each output file manually to find the gap.
